text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Grrraaah! I'm getting an incoming call from the brain cells in my teal matter! They're telling me you're the culprit!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hwah! What is this all about?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Don't you know? I'm the great Detective Golshi! And I know you're behind this. The evidence lines up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're a d-detective?! Um, did something bad happen?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? That doesn't sound like something the culprit would say… My bad! Sorry for turning the heat up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If you were the culprit, you would've let something slip about this lethal clothespin here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see! So that's how you'll find the culprit! But I promise you, it's not me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Great Golshi! Would you allow me to help you find them?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to find the true criminal! Villains should never go unpunished!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You got promise in yer eyes there, kid. Right, then! I'll make you my assistant! Let's hit the crime scene for clues!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! I won't let you down!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ka-zing! That's it! I've cracked the case! The culprit was looking for some fishcakes!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But is it even possible to make a getaway with fishcakes in your mouth while dribbling backwards?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've done plenty of analyzing, and this is the only plausible answer I can think of!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let me try to replicate their actions! Please wait here and observe!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …Try what now? Are you being serious? Just slow down a minute!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll stuff a fesh cake im my mouf… and den rum at full shpeeeed!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: S-Satonoooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… I did it! I busted their little scheme!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sh-she really pulled it off! She's one mad Uma!
